Known structural loss: a flat list cannot show which ligand occupies which vertex, which is precisely what distinguishes the two isomers -- for the record, the cis drawing has Cl at the top vertex and Cl at the upper-right with four NH3 at the remaining vertices, while the trans drawing has Cl at the top and Cl at the bottom (mutually opposite) with four NH3 around the equator.
